cohort: Women who underwent delivery (n=1868) at a rural referral hospital in Tanzania between January and August 2013
finding: The introduction of a caesarean section audit system in a rural Tanzanian hospital was associated with a decrease in the proportion of unjustified caesarean sections, but did not lead to a change in the overall caesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The rate of assisted vacuum delivery did not increase following the introduction of the audit system.
